verdict.rationale: Formant's evidence shows a ROS-aware agent that ingests telemetry, publishes to ROS topics, and runs adapters. None of it documents ready-made drivers for cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS, or Formant-defined standard sensor message types. ROS compatibility and generic telemetry ingestion are adjacent host-platform and building-block capabilities, not the sensor-driver integration this story asks for.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can integrate cameras, lidars, IMUs, and GPS with ready-made drivers and standard message types
